newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise up on sector re-rating hopes.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise up on sector re-rating hopes.

text.p: Shares in Enterprise Oil Plc jumped for a second day on Thursday amid hopes for a re-rating in the oil exploration sector following Gulf Canada's bid for Clyde Petroleum Plc.
The stock was up 15-1/2p at 611 by 0940 GMT, after earlier reaching a record 614p.
Other oil exploration stocks also extended Wednesday's gains with Lasmo Plc up 3-1/2p at 230-1/2 and British Borneo Plc up 22-1/2p at 694.
"Enterprise is good following the bid and hopes for a re-rating in the sector," said one trader.
Nick Antill, an analyst at brokers BZW, said Gulf Canada's bid for Clyde Petroleum had established an independent market valuation for other companies in the sector.
"For a year now we've seen a stream of bids for exploration and production companies and very high prices for assets at auction," he said.

"When it's clear the value of companies' asets, if they were put on the market, is relatively high, you would expect the share price to reflect that. So what the bid has done is to establish an independent market valuation by analogy for other companies in that sector."
